description: This Java source file defines a singleton class 'ThingSearchCommandMappingStrategies' that provides mapping strategies from 'ThingsSearchCommand' signals to 'JsonifiableMapper' instances, specifically for different subscription-related commands in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

classes.name: ThingSearchCommandMappingStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class providing mapping strategies from 'ThingSearchCommand' signals to JSON mappers, specific to subscription command types in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns a map of command type strings to corresponding JSON mapper functions.

methods.description: Extracts a set of namespace strings from the adaptable object.

methods.description: Retrieves an optional filter string from the adaptable object.
